notes.title: Release Candidate 2 Review Update
notes.notes:
Unscripted Release Candidate 2 (RC2) is now eligible for review/playthrough for streamers, reviewers, influencers, press, and developers. RC2 represents the stable build that players can expect when downloading the game Steam.

For visual novel developers and/or modders, the corresponding Core bundle for RC2 represents the first stable version of the module and can be considered production-ready.

To request a copy for review or streaming, contact unscriptedvn @ marquiskurt.net, send a direct message to Twitter at @UnscriptedVN, or join the Discord server.
